channel.title: Nature Physics
channel.description: Nature Physics offers news and reviews alongside top-quality research papers in a monthly publication, covering the entire spectrum of physics. Physics addresses the properties and interactions of matter and energy, and plays a key role in the development of a broad range of technologies. To reflect this, Nature Physics covers all areas of pure and applied physics research. The journal focuses on core physics disciplines, but is also open to a broad range of topics whose central theme falls within the bounds of physics.

item.title: [7] Superconductivity with a squeeze
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Michael E. Ziebel

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Heavy-fermion superconductivity in van der Waals materials is relevant to broader quantum materials interests.

Tags: #vanderWaals #superconductivity #heavyfermion

Abstract: Heavy-fermion superconductivity has now been observed under pressure in the van der Waals metal CeSiI. This material will provide a new platform for studying the interplay of dimensionality and Kondo physics.

item.title: [7] Superconductivity under pressure in a van der Waals heavy-fermion metal
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Hechang Lei, Jinguang Cheng

Authors: Tong Shi, Wenhao Li, Qingxin Dong, et al.

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Study of heavy-fermion physics and pressure-induced superconductivity in layered materials.

Tags: #vanderWaals #heavyfermion #superconductivity

Abstract: CeSiI is a two-dimensional heavy-fermion metal. Now, the interplay between antiferromagnetism, Kondo coherence and unconventional superconductivity is observed by applying pressure to this material.
